# Documentation toolchain:  pip install -r requirements-docs.txt
#
# Separate from requirements-dev.txt on purpose. Building the docs must not add
# anything to what `pip install pydepi` pulls in -- these packages are never
# runtime or install dependencies of any distribution in packages/.
#
# Only the core package is installed here. The API reference is generated by
# griffe via static analysis of the source tree (see `paths` in mkdocs.yml), so
# the adapter modules are read without importing them and their web frameworks
# do not need to be present.

-e packages/depi-core

mkdocs-material>=9.5
mkdocstrings[python]>=0.26
